title: LoFi Typing Remix
tagline: A calm, mobile-first typing app with WPM, accuracy and a lofi mood. No build step.
stateNote: A small static site, last changed in August 2025.
problem: Typing practice is usually stressful. This keeps the numbers (WPM, accuracy, time) with a calm look and optional music.
contribution: It is my project: a static site meant for Netlify.
worksToday: The README describes real-time WPM and accuracy, a custom caret, light and dark themes and a hidden input for mobile.
